Eight places to keep handy, each checked to load before being listed here.

- **FDA guidance: *Part 11, Electronic Records; Electronic Signatures — Scope and Application*
  (2003)** — <https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/part-11-electronic-records-electronic-signatures-scope-and-application>.
  The guidance this module's four-part legacy-system test, its changed-system sentence, and its
  "Copies of Records" section all come from. Use it when you want the full "Legacy Systems" and
  "Copies of Records" sections in context, alongside the predicate-rule material last module
  already pulled from the same document.

- **FDA guidance: *Data Integrity and Compliance With Drug CGMP: Questions and Answers* (2018)** —
  <https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/data-integrity-and-compliance-drug-cgmp-questions-and-answers>.
  Source for the static/dynamic distinction and the pH-meter/FT-IR comparison (Question 10) module
  3 quoted in full and this module applies directly to Lakeshore's own legacy instrument. Reread
  Question 10 here if you want the original pH-meter and FT-IR language side by side with this
  module's own resolution.

- **Cornell Legal Information Institute (LII): 21 CFR § 11.10** —
  <https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/11.10>. A clean, citable, non-FDA rendering of the full
  closed-systems control list, including paragraph (b) (the copy-generation requirement this
  module's "Copies of Records" section names, but doesn't re-quote in full) and paragraph (e) (the
  audit-trail requirement module 2 already reconciled with the predicate rule underneath it).

- **[21 CFR Part 11 – 2003 Guidance - Online Course](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1JIh8e7wC0E)**
  (Learnaboutgmp Online Training, from oEmbed `author_name`) — the video embedded in this lesson. A
  commercial training-channel walk-through of the 2003 *Scope and Application* guidance. General
  GxP training, not blood-specific; it is background, not a regulator statement. Verified embeddable
  via YouTube oEmbed on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

- **[FDA: Part 11 Scope and Application guidance, full PDF](https://www.fda.gov/media/75414/download)**
  — the complete 2003 guidance as a single document. Read it when you want the Legacy Systems and
  Copies of Records sections in the surrounding context of the other enforcement-discretion
  sections (validation, audit trails, record retention). Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11
  (HTTP 200).

- **[FDA: General Principles of Software Validation](https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/general-principles-software-validation)**
  — FDA's own risk-based framing of how much validation evidence software warrants. Written for
  device software, so read it for the fitness-for-use reasoning behind criterion 4, not as a
  blood-establishment requirement. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

- **[Cornell LII: 21 CFR § 11.1 (scope)](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/11.1)** — the
  regulation-tier statement of what Part 11 covers, which is the rule the legacy-system
  enforcement-discretion policy sits on top of. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11
  (HTTP 200).

- **[Cornell LII: 21 CFR § 606.160](https://www.law.cornell.edu/cfr/text/21/606.160)** — the
  blood-establishment records regulation: the predicate rule that keeps applying to LAB-07's
  records whatever Part 11's enforcement status is. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11
  (HTTP 200).

- **[AABB: Standards](https://www.aabb.org/standards-accreditation/standards)** — AABB's official
  standards landing page, where the Equipment-related Quality System Essential the lesson mentions
  (paraphrased only) is published; the standards text itself is AABB's and is not reproduced here.
  Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200).

## Keep learning

Not official sources — good places to learn more about living with legacy systems and compensating controls.

- **[Data Integrity Focus, Part III: What Is the Problem with Hybrid Systems?](https://www.chromatographyonline.com/view/data-integrity-focus-part-iii-what-problem-hybrid-systems)** (LCGC International) — Legacy instruments often end up hybrid (electronic result, paper record); this article explains the risks and the controls practitioners reach for. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200). Page title checked.
- **[The Practical Aspect: Challenges of Security Log Management](https://www.isaca.org/resources/isaca-journal/issues/2017/volume-6/the-practical-aspect-challenges-of-security-log-management)** (ISACA Journal) — When a system cannot log what you need, monitoring around it is the usual compensating control; this shows how to run such a program. Supports CISSP Domain 7. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200). Page title checked.
- **[Log Management as an Enabler for Data Protection and Automated Threat Detection](https://www.isaca.org/resources/isaca-journal/issues/2023/volume-4/log-management-as-an-enabler-for-data-protection-and-automated-threat-detection)** (ISACA Journal) — Explains what is lost when logging has gaps, a good way to explain the risk of an unmodernized system to non-technical leaders. Verified loading via `curl` on 2026-11-11 (HTTP 200). Page title checked.
